facts.fact: On 31 July 2026 RASCOM's director general said the pan-African satellite organisation's services are already used in Côte d'Ivoire, citing the national broadcaster RTI's use of RASCOM satellite capacity during the 2023 Africa Cup of Nations.

systems.country_label: Organisation régionale africaine de Communications par Satellite (Rascom)
systems.owner: RASCOM (created 1992 under African Union auspices, headquartered in Abidjan-Plateau)
systems.tiers: national (RTI broadcaster; ministry exploring rural internet and universal-service use)
